summary: Support authentic pre-first-D3D11-Draw D3D9 backbuffer LockRect/UnlockRect and GetDC/ReleaseDC color writes after game full Clear: capture successful complete current D3D9 pixels and seed following native SM3/FVF Draw without stale writable tickets; reject foreign/open/failed writes and retain original D3D9 game/input/FFB/Present. Build and Quest3 runtime not yet proven.

feature_contract.goal: Mirror actual pre-first-native-Draw D3D9 LockRect/GetDC authored menu, vehicle and race backbuffer writes into subsequent D3D11 SM3/FVF color while preserving original fallback and source chronology.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A successful game-owned partial LockRect/UnlockRect on canonical cleared backbuffer captures all final full game color before first native Draw.
A later GetDC/ReleaseDC before first native Draw refreshes complete D3D9 backbuffer pixels without stale open CPU write ticket.
Wrong owner or rect, open writes, unavailable readback, failed completion and post-first-Draw without native target retain unchanged original D3D9 Draw/Present/input and invalidate DX11 snapshot.
All five mandatory DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD checks pass for this exact validation-bearing result commit.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: D3D9 backbuffer full Clear -> LockRect/UnlockRect partial write -> second GetDC/ReleaseDC -> complete pre-Draw seed -> SM3/FVF native first Draw and safe original game Present.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Unfinished/foreign/mismatched CPU/GDI tickets, unsupported backbuffer extent, failed readback/finish and active native writes never publish invented DX11 pixels.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 locked game CPU authoring + bounded staging snapshot + native SM3/FVF first Draw with ticket retirement; original D3D9 Present/input/FFB survives.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Diagnostic NativeDrawPathActive opt-in only; original D3D9/gamepad/FFB/Present unchanged for every unsupported or failed source write; DXVK frozen.

real_game_draw_blocker: Native pre-Draw LockRect/GetDC write did not admit an owned CPU ticket or close it after current full D3D9 snapshot.
next_implementation_action: Resolve exact-SHA mandatory GitHub Gate if it reports an actual failure; runtime HMD remains UNTESTED.
